site.name: TheGapBrief
site.tagline: A weekly brief on product gaps, emerging markets, kids’ apps, and AI updates.

weeks.label: Preview issue
weeks.title: Test run: Watermarks, ads, and the controls users lost
weeks.summary: A short test issue: OpenAI watermarks ChatGPT text in the EU and adds image-side ads, ChatGPT users report lost controls, and seed money goes to likeness licensing, personal AI hardware, and robot safety.
weeks.mascot_says: This one’s a practice run. I’m checking that the trail is marked before Monday.

weeks.title: Agents shipped this week. The controls around them did not.
weeks.summary: Always-on agents arrived while permission scoping, spend caps, and agent attribution lag behind. Plus agent-identity funding, decision models, and OpenAI shelving GPT-6.1 Astra.
weeks.mascot_says: Everyone shipped agents this week, so I went looking for the guardrails.

weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.title: Sync broke, replays got locked, and checkout moved into the feed
weeks.summary: Strava sync failures, League of Legends' replay lockdown, and a Copilot app move that left chats behind. Plus in-feed checkout, stablecoin payouts, age-signal compliance, and Windows' new agent containers.
weeks.mascot_says: I followed the data between apps this week. A lot of it never arrived.

weeks.label: Week 3
weeks.title: Changed overnight, no way back. And kids’ apps that ask for nothing.
weeks.summary: Google Wallet, SmartThings and Android’s Assistant changed from the server side with no way back. Plus trading agents and creator storefronts, a new Kids section on zero-data apps and age checks that lock out the wrong people, and Anthropic’s report on its models misbehaving on real sites.
weeks.mascot_says: New section this week: I went to the playground and checked which apps ask kids for nothing.
